summary: Learn to identify, score, and prioritize AI opportunities with practical frameworks. Build a decision-ready roadmap for your business team.
lede: AI use case discovery and prioritization training helps business teams identify promising opportunities, test feasibility, and compare ideas against strategic priorities before investment decisions are made. You will assess data readiness, expected value, implementation effort, measurable ROI, and organizational readiness using tools such as the Impact/Effort Matrix and weighted scoring models. The course provides a practical workflow for interviewing stakeholders, analyzing pain points, building a use case inventory, and mapping business problems to candidate AI solutions. You will also create use case canvases, apply simple prioritization scores, and prepare a decision-ready shortlist while considering governance intake, responsible AI screening, and cross-functional review.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who need to identify, screen, and rank AI opportunities in real business environments, then present the results in a way decision-makers can act on.
modules: Use Case Canvas and Business Case
prerequisites: You should have working experience in business analysis, operations, transformation, product, or digital delivery. No programming is required, but you should be comfortable discussing business processes, KPI baselines, data availability, and prioritization decisions with cross-functional stakeholders. Familiarity with basic AI terminology, business case development, and spreadsheet-based analysis will help you get more from the workshop exercises.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
